items.name: crypto-lab-pq-rotation
items.description: Browser-based post-quantum migration planner for operational teams. Hybrid X.509 certs (ECDSA-P256 + ML-DSA-65), multi-jurisdiction regulatory timelines (CNSA 2.0, NIS, NCSC, BSI...), and a rolling key-rotation simulator with canary and rollback.

items.name: vril-kem
items.description: 🔏 VRIL-KEM is a post-quantum Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) built on Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE). It provides a drop-in replacement for classical key exchange in any TLS, SSH, or application-layer protocol — protecting encrypted communications against both classical and quantum adversaries.

items.name: awesome-cbom

items.name: pq-tls-readiness
items.description: A terminal-only pipeline for measuring post-quantum TLS deployment: dual-probe key-exchange capability, active TLS 1.3 certificate retrieval, and two-signal hosting attribution.

items.name: BJBank
items.description: Your money, protected for the quantum era. SEPA transfers, MB WAY, virtual cards and statistics, all in one simple app protected with post-quantum cryptography (PQC), biometrics and email OTP.

items.name: pqc-mat
items.description: PQC-MAT ships VECTOR — a post-quantum cryptography migration toolkit with CodeQL-based crypto discovery (Code), TLS/SSH cipher & KEM inventory (Network), CBOM quantum risk scoring against NIST/BSI/ANSSI standards (Score), and a browser-based scan & review interface (GUI).

items.name: crypto-lab-harvest-vault

items.name: QUOTAS
items.description: QUOTAS (Quantum-safe OT Assessment Sandbox): An automated, Dockerized testbed designed to evaluate the steady-state latency and variance of industrial protocols (Modbus, S7comm, OPC UA) routed through Post-Quantum VPN gateways under constrained edge-hardware conditions.
